title: Turn your research into a ready-to-share slidedeck—instantly
summary: Introducing Motives PowerPoint export: turn qualitative findings into ready-to-share slide decks instantly, with every quote linked to its video clip.
body_markdown:
### Need to make a slide deck? We’ve got you covered.


We know the slide deck is often the go-to format for many teams when it comes to sharing consumer insights with stakeholders. That’s why, after strong demand, we’re excited to introduce **PowerPoint export** . Now, you can turn your Motives findings into a professionally designed, ready-to-share slide deck—instantly.


No copy-pasting. No formatting headaches. Just intelligent insights, delivered.


‍


### Introducing Motives Powerpoint export:


- Built around modular **insight blocks** that convert directly into **beautifully laid-out slides**
- Every customer quote in the slide deck includes a direct link to its corresponding video clip
- All content remains accessible to everyone in your company **‍** ‍


‍


At Motives, we help you get consumer insights in front of the people who matter most.


For more info about our new features, contacthello@motives.ai


We cannot wait to hear your feedback.
